prompts.title: README.md
prompts.prompt:
This script first uses the T2V model to generate the first shot as the initial memory. It then uses our M2V model to generate the remaining shots shot by shot, automatically extracting keyframes and updating the memory after each shot. **Key arguments**: - `story_script_path`: Path to the story script JSON file. - `output_dir`: Directory to save the generated videos. Default is `./results`. - `t2v_model_path`: Path to the T2V model. Default is `./models/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B`. - `i2v_model_path`: Path to the I2V model. Default is `./models/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B`. - `lora_weight_path`: Path to the M2V LoRA weights. Default is `./models/StoryMem`. - `seed`: Random seed. Default is `0`. - `size`: Output video resolution. Default is `832*480`. - `max_memory_size`: Maximum number of shots to keep in memory. Default is `10`. - `t2v_first_shot`: Use T2V to generate the first shot as the initial memory. - `m2v_first_shot`: Use M2V to generate the first shot (for the MR2V setting, where reference images are provided as initial memory). Reference images should be placed in `output_dir` as `00_00_keyframe0.jpg`, ..., `00_00_keyframeN.jpg`. - `mi2v`: Enable MI2V (memory + first-frame image conditioning) to connect adjacent shots when `scene_cut` is `False`. - `mm2v`: Enable MM2V (memory + first 5 motion frames conditioning) to connect adjacent shots when `scene_cut` is `False`. ### ST-Bench To support evaluating multi-shot long video storytelling, we establish and release *ST-Bench*, which can be found in the subfloder `./story`. We prompt GPT-5 to create 30 long story scripts spanning diverse styles, each containing a story overview, 8–12 shot-level text prompts, and scene-cut indicators. In total, *ST-Bench* provides 300 detailed video prompts describing characters, scenes, dynamic events, shot types, and possibly camera movements. To create your own story script, you can follow the system prompt below, which we use to generate structured, shot-level story scripts:
System prompt for story script (click to expand) > You are an expert director of story videos. Your task is to design a story script about [..., e.g. a funny man]. > > Each prompt corresponds to a five-second video clip, so avoid overly complex text rendering, extreme motions, or audio-dependent effects. The overall story should remain simple, clear, and easy to follow. > > Your output must follow the JSON format shown in the example: > > [ ... an example json story script here, e.g. `./story/black.json` ... ] > > **Field Instructions**: > > - **story_overview**: A concise summary of the whole story. > - **scene_num**: Sequential index of the scene. > - **cut**: Whether this prompt starts with a scene cut: > - `"True"`: a new cut. > - `"False"`: continue smoothly from the last frame of the previous prompt. Must ensure the two adjacent prompts can be naturally concatenated into a smooth continuous clip. > - The first prompt in the story must always have `"True"`. > - **video_prompts**: A list of text-to-video prompts forming the story beats within the scene. Prompts should reflect natural, smooth, and logical story progression. > > **What Each Video Prompt Should Describe (if relevant)** > > - **Characters**: appearance, attire, age, style. > - **Actions & interactions**: motion, gestures, expressions, eye contact, simple physical actions. > - **Scene & background**: indoor/outdoor location, props, layout, lighting, environment details. > - **Atmosphere & mood**: emotional tone, colors, aesthetic feeling. > - **Camera & editing**: shot type (e.g., close-up / medium / wide), simple camera movement, transitions. > > The prompts should be concise but sufficiently detailed (1–4 sentences). > > Return only a valid JSON story script.
To improve consistency, it would be better to provide more explicit character descriptions in each shot prompt, helping the model match the intended memory. ## ❤️ Ackowledgement Our implementation is based on [Wan2.2](https://github.com/Wan-Video/Wan2.2/tree/main). Thanks for the great open-source work! ## 📌 Citation If any part of our paper or code is helpful to your research, please consider citing our work 📝 and give us a star ⭐. Thanks for your support!

`story_script_path`: المسار إلى ملف JSON للبرنامج النصي للقصة. - `output_dir`: دليل لحفظ مقاطع الفيديو التي تم إنشاؤها. الافتراضي هو `./النتائج`. - `t2v_model_path`: المسار إلى نموذج T2V. الافتراضي هو `./models/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B`. - readme.md prompt-engineering this script first uses the t2v model to generate the first shot as the initial memory. it then uses our m2v model to generate the remaining shots shot by shot, automatically extracting keyframes and updating the memory after each shot. **key arguments**: - `story_script_path`: path to the story script json file. - `output_dir`: directory to save the generated videos. default is `./results`. - `t2v_model_path`: path to the t2v model. default is `./models/wan2.2-t2v-a14b`. - `i2v_model_path`: path to the i2v model. default is `./models/wan2.2-i2v-a14b`. - `lora_weight_path`: path to the m2v lora weights. default is `./models/storymem`. - `seed`: random seed. default is `0`. - `size`: output video resolution. default is `832*480`. - `max_memory_size`: maximum number of shots to keep in memory. default is `10`. - `t2v_first_shot`: use t2v to generate the first shot as the initial memory. - `m2v_first_shot`: use m2v to generate the first shot (for the mr2v setting, where reference images are provided as initial memory). reference images should be placed in `output_dir` as `00_00_keyframe0.jpg`, ..., `00_00_keyframen.jpg`. - `mi2v`: enable mi2v (memory + first-frame image conditioning) to connect adjacent shots when `scene_cut` is `false`. - `mm2v`: enable mm2v (memory + first 5 motion frames conditioning) to connect adjacent shots when `scene_cut` is `false`. ### st-bench to support evaluating multi-shot long video storytelling, we establish and release *st-bench*, which can be found in the subfloder `./story`. we prompt gpt-5 to create 30 long story scripts spanning diverse styles, each containing a story overview, 8–12 shot-level text prompts, and scene-cut indicators. in total, *st-bench* provides 300 detailed video prompts describing characters, scenes, dynamic events, shot types, and possibly camera movements. to create your own story script, you can follow the system prompt below, which we use to generate structured, shot-level story scripts:
system prompt for story script (click to expand) > you are an expert director of story videos. your task is to design a story script about [..., e.g. a funny man]. > > each prompt corresponds to a five-second video clip, so avoid overly complex text rendering, extreme motions, or audio-dependent effects. the overall story should remain simple, clear, and easy to follow. > > your output must follow the json format shown in the example: > > [ ... an example json story script here, e.g. `./story/black.json` ... ] > > **field instructions**: > > - **story_overview**: a concise summary of the whole story. > - **scene_num**: sequential index of the scene. > - **cut**: whether this prompt starts with a scene cut: > - `"true"`: a new cut. > - `"false"`: continue smoothly from the last frame of the previous prompt. must ensure the two adjacent prompts can be naturally concatenated into a smooth continuous clip. > - the first prompt in the story must always have `"true"`. > - **video_prompts**: a list of text-to-video prompts forming the story beats within the scene. prompts should reflect natural, smooth, and logical story progression. > > **what each video prompt should describe (if relevant)** > > - **characters**: appearance, attire, age, style. > - **actions & interactions**: motion, gestures, expressions, eye contact, simple physical actions. > - **scene & background**: indoor/outdoor location, props, layout, lighting, environment details. > - **atmosphere & mood**: emotional tone, colors, aesthetic feeling. > - **camera & editing**: shot type (e.g., close-up / medium / wide), simple camera movement, transitions. > > the prompts should be concise but sufficiently detailed (1–4 sentences). > > return only a valid json story script.
to improve consistency, it would be better to provide more explicit character descriptions in each shot prompt, helping the model match the intended memory. ## ❤️ ackowledgement our implementation is based on [wan2.2](https://github.com/wan-video/wan2.2/tree/main). thanks for the great open-source work! ## 📌 citation if any part of our paper or code is helpful to your research, please consider citing our work 📝 and give us a star ⭐. thanks for your support! github review wan wan

### Print from USB

Lists all `.mp4` files found on the inserted USB drive. Selecting a file:

1. If the filename encodes an RPM (e.g. `part_9rpm.mp4`), the motor speed is pre-set automatically.
2. A **RPM adjustment screen** appears — rotate to change, click to confirm and start the print.
3. The projector displays a black image while in this menu — this is intentional to avoid accidentally curing resin while browsing.
4. A **Print Status screen** shows while the print is running. Click to stop.
5. If **USB video prompt** is enabled (see Settings), you will be asked whether to save the camera recording to USB after stopping.

> **Note:** Files with "recording" in the filename are hidden from this list (they are camera output files). Avoid using "recording" in your print filenames.

> **Recording format:** The camera saves recordings as `.h264` (raw H.264 bitstream), not `.mp4`. To convert for playback on a computer:

1. إذا كان اسم الملف يشفر دورة في الدقيقة (على سبيل المثال، `part_9rpm.mp4`)، فسيتم ضبط سرعة المحرك مسبقًا تلقائيًا.

4. تظهر **شاشة حالة الطباعة** أثناء تشغيل الطباعة. انقر للتوقف.

prompts.prompt:
Write a video prompt with exactly [NUMBER] segments describing [YOUR SUBJECT/SCENARIO].

Rules:
1. Begin each segment with a header on its own line. Format: one word, a space, a number, a colon. Example: Scene 1:
2. Write the segment text on the line after the header.
3. Segment 1 describes only the static visible state of the provided input. No motion. No action. Nothing not present in the input.
4. Each segment after segment 1 describes only what is changing or moving during that period. Do not repeat anything from segment 1.
5. Output only the formatted segments. Nothing else.

1. ابدأ كل مقطع برأس على السطر الخاص به. التنسيق: كلمة واحدة، مسافة، رقم، نقطتين. مثال: المشهد 1:
2. اكتب نص المقطع على السطر الذي يلي الرأس.
3. يصف الجزء 1 فقط الحالة المرئية الثابتة للإدخال المقدم. لا حركة. لا يوجد إجراء. لا شيء غير موجود في الإدخال.
4. يصف كل مقطع بعد الجزء 1 فقط ما يتغير أو يتحرك خلال تلك الفترة. لا تكرر أي شيء من الجزء 1.
5. إخراج المقاطع المنسقة فقط. لا شيء آخر.

prompts.prompt: / DCFRCANMA./ A hand-drawn illustration in ink and watercolor/ rendered in muted tones of sage green/ dusty blue/ warm orange/ and cream. The scene is a tall studio room with sloped wooden ceiling and exposed beams; walls are papered in pale green. A person with reddish hair sits at a wooden desk at the left side of the frame/ hunched forward slightly in a posture of concentration/ wearing an orange-red jacket over blue clothing. Around them on the desk/ shelves/ and floor is the accumulated evidence of creative work: stacks of paper/ paintbrushes in cups/ containers of supplies/ sketches pinned or scattered/ jars of pigment/ open books/ wooden rulers. Behind and radiating from the figure's head is a visible aura of light—soft golden and pale blue glows/ as if consciousness itself is luminous and spilling outward. The light halos the figure's silhouette without obscuring the drawn details. To the right/ a large window frames a view of a coastal town with terracotta rooflines/ pale buildings clustered on hillside/ and turquoise-green water beyond/ rendered in softer focus. The composition follows the rule of thirds/ with the figure and window balanced. Every surface shows wear and texture: weathered wood/ paper curled at edges/ dust on shelves/ the matte finish of watercolor pigment. The light suggests late afternoon. The work is detailed but not photographic—it has the warmth and humanity of a careful hand-drawn scene/ intimate and observational/ capturing both the stillness of work and the inner brightness of attention itself.

prompts.prompt: / dcd@rkf@ntsy./ A chrome robotic figure kneels with head tilted back and arms curved inward/ positioned left of center in the frame. The body is polished metal with clean edges and flowing curves; light glints off the shoulders and chest. Water droplets/ some the size of ball bearings/ scatter across the frame at varied depths/ some striking the robot's surface with visible impact/ others caught mid-fall between camera and subject. The background is a flat bright yellow/ unbroken and even. The robot reads as a silhouette/ its form defined sharply against the yellow void/ backlit so highlights rim the edges where chrome catches hard light. Moisture beads on the metal surfaces as if the figure has just emerged from water. The ground beneath is undefined/ dissolving into the yellow. The photograph has weight and texture—metallic surfaces show wear marks and fingerprints/ water creates small shadows where it clings. No drama in tone/ only in the gesture of raised head and the spray suspended in air around it. Shot with shallow depth/ droplets in immediate foreground slightly out of focus. The mood is quiet—a moment of relief or release/ captured with the documentary clarity of a high-speed photograph.

الموضوع والوضع
امرأة شابة siiesfrtdeer تقف في المناظر الطبيعية المغطاة بالثلوج والمضاءة بنور القمر. إنها تواجه جانبًا قليلاً، وتعبيرها هادئ ولكنه قوي. يظهر وجهها الشاحب جزئيًا تحت عباءة كبيرة داكنة اللون تغطي رأسها وكتفيها. تظهر شفاه حمراء ناعمة وعيون هادئة وحازمة. تهيمن العباءة على التركيبة، مع التركيز على العزلة والقوة.

الإعداد والجو
تتساقط رقاقات الثلج بلطف حولها، وتستقر على قماش العباءة. الخلفية مظلمة وغامضة وتتناقض مع الثلج اللامع. يبدو المشهد هادئًا ومعزولًا وسينمائيًا، لحظة متجمدة في الزمن، ممسكًا بالمنجل، مزدوج الاستخدام، سلاحًا ملتهبًا، نارًا سوداء.

الملابس والتفاصيل
عباءة ثقيلة ومزخرفة بتطريز دقيق أو حواف بالية. ظهور ومضات خفيفة من الصقيع على القماش. في الأسفل، توجد تلميحات من ملابس القرون الوسطى أو الملابس الخيالية، وربما درع جلدي أو ياقة سترة تطل من خلالها. 7481llu، Smo0thL1nes، 0011001001، sw33t.

الإضاءة والجو
يضيء ضوء القمر البارد المزرق وجهها وحواف عباءتها. على النقيض من الخلفية المظلمة، تم تصميم الإضاءة قليلاً للدراما. نغمات باردة مع الضوء الدافئ على الجلد. تلمع رقاقات الثلج في الهواء، مما يخلق العمق والحركة.

الأسلوب والتقديم
واقعية الرسم مع فرشاة ناعمة. نسيج مفصل على العباءة والثلج. تركيبة متوازنة مع تباين قوي بين العباءة الداكنة والثلج الشاحب. خلفية ضبابية، وعمق الميدان.

prompts.prompt: / M4n4r4/ european comic book masterpiece/ ink and watercolor/ A woman in black silhouette stands with arms spread wide in a gesture of transcendence/ one hand lifted higher than the other/ her body long and elegant. Flowing white robes billow around her torso and legs as if caught in wind/ the fabric creasing and folding with weight and motion. Behind her head burns a perfect circle of pale luminous light/ ringed by rays of light extending outward like spokes. She is positioned in the lower third of the frame/ rising up from a low horizon of ornate fantasy architecture. Surrounding her and stretching back is a sprawling steampunk cityscape rendered in the style of classical hand-painted fantasy illustration—gossamer watercolor washes layered over precise linework. Golden-yellow spires and towers with domed caps and narrow apertures climb upward. Ornate stonework/ decorative carvings/ statuary/ and mechanical details fill the foreground and midground: wrought iron railings with geometric patterns/ bronze sculptures/ carved friezes. An airship with a red and gold envelope floats in the middle distance. Snow-capped mountains rise beyond. Pale blue sky spreads above with touches of rose and cream where light catches clouds. The entire scene is bathed in warm metallic light—golds and pale creams against muted ochres and burnt oranges—as if lit by late afternoon sun striking ancient stone. The figure's black form and white drapery create a sharp silhouette that reads clearly against the complex architecture behind her. Fine lines throughout suggest hand-rendered illustration. The composition uses rule of thirds with the figure placed at one intersection/ the city spreading across the frame with depth receding toward distant peaks.

prompts.prompt: A man in a faded plaid shirt with the top button undone stands in a dry field with his right hand resting on his hip and his left arm at his side/ weight evenly distributed. Weathered wooden fence posts rise from the ground around them/ their surfaces gray with age and splitting from sun. Behind and above the figures/ the landscape recedes in planes: pale tan and yellow grass in the immediate ground/ dark sage scrub/ then a dense line of dark green evergreens marking the far field. Beyond that/ a ridge of snow-capped mountains rises in shades of lavender and pale gray. The sky occupies the upper third and is a deep saturated blue fading to lighter blue at the horizon/ with soft white cumulus clouds drifting left of center. Embedded subtly throughout the sky and visible as a faint pattern in the distant mountains are concentric rings of watchful eyes/ rendered so delicately they appear almost as atmospheric distortion or mist rather than subjects—golden and amber tones in the eye irises catch what daylight there is. The entire image has the color palette and slight grain of Kodachrome color film stock from the 1950s or 1960s/ with warm shadows and a slightly desaturated quality that brings the blues and ambers into harmony. The light is clear and natural/ casting soft shadows across the grass. Power lines run at angles across the sky. The composition follows the rule of thirds/ with the man positioned at the intersection of right and center vertical lines/ and the horizon placed in the upper third of the frame.

Her left hand rests at her hip; her right arm extends loose at her side/ palm open. She wears a pale cream linen crop top that catches warm afternoon light/ paired with high-waisted black trousers with subtle texture. The fabrics have weight and wear—natural fiber showing its age softly. Around her midsection hangs a wide woven belt of pale natural fiber/ woven in concentric circles/ the kind that holds real weight. Behind her/ bright sunlight illuminates classical stone columns and white architecture; in the deep background/ fountain water catches the sun/ and flowering shrubs in bloom create pockets of blue/ pink/ and soft green foliage. The plaza's pale stone floor meets a painted sky—the high horizon sits in the upper third/ showing open sky and the building's pale stone facade. Warm golden light from the side catches the side of her face and shoulders/ creating soft shadows along her collarbone and neck. The color palette is saturated: pale neutral tones on her body/ rich greens and bluing florals in the background/ pale stone/ and a bright luminous sky. The light quality is documentary—natural daylight/ not theatrical—shot as photograph in 35mm color film stock/ clear and direct.

prompts.prompt:
Subject and pose
A young woman stands in a snowy, moonlit landscape. She faces slightly sideways, her expression serene yet powerful. Her pale face is partially visible beneath a large, dark hooded cloak that covers her head and shoulders. Soft red lips and calm, determined eyes are visible. The cloak dominates the composition, emphasizing solitude and strength.

Setting and atmosphere
Snowflakes fall gently around her, resting on the cloak’s textured fabric. The background is dark and mysterious, contrasting with the bright snow. The scene feels quiet, isolated, and cinematic, a moment frozen in time, holding scythe, dual wielding, flaming weapon, black fire.

Clothing and details
Heavy, textured cloak with subtle embroidery or worn edges. Faint glints of frost on the fabric. Underneath, hints of medieval or fantasy attire, perhaps a leather armor or tunic collar peeking through. 7481llu, Smo0thL1nes, 0011001001, sw33t.

Lighting and atmosphere
Cold, bluish moonlight illuminates her face and the edges of the cloak. Contrasting with the dark background, the lighting is slightly stylized for drama. Cool tones with warm highlights on skin. Snowflakes shimmer in the air, creating depth and motion.

Style and rendering
Painterly realism with soft brushwork. Detailed texture on the cloak and snow. Balanced composition with strong contrast between dark cloak and pale snow. blurry background, depth of field.

prompts.prompt_ar:
الموضوع والوضع
امرأة شابة تقف في منطقة ثلجية مقمرة. إنها تواجه جانبًا قليلاً، وتعبيرها هادئ ولكنه قوي. يظهر وجهها الشاحب جزئيًا تحت عباءة كبيرة داكنة اللون تغطي رأسها وكتفيها. تظهر شفاه حمراء ناعمة وعيون هادئة وحازمة. تهيمن العباءة على التركيبة، مع التركيز على العزلة والقوة.

الإعداد والجو
تتساقط رقاقات الثلج بلطف حولها، وتستقر على قماش العباءة. الخلفية مظلمة وغامضة وتتناقض مع الثلج اللامع. يبدو المشهد هادئًا ومعزولًا وسينمائيًا، لحظة متجمدة في الزمن، ممسكًا بالمنجل، مزدوج الاستخدام، سلاحًا ملتهبًا، نارًا سوداء.

الملابس والتفاصيل
عباءة ثقيلة ومزخرفة بتطريز دقيق أو حواف بالية. ظهور ومضات خفيفة من الصقيع على القماش. في الأسفل، توجد تلميحات من ملابس القرون الوسطى أو الملابس الخيالية، وربما درع جلدي أو ياقة سترة تطل من خلالها. 7481llu، Smo0thL1nes، 0011001001، sw33t.

الإضاءة والجو
يضيء ضوء القمر البارد المزرق وجهها وحواف عباءتها. على النقيض من الخلفية المظلمة، تم تصميم الإضاءة قليلاً للدراما. نغمات باردة مع الضوء الدافئ على الجلد. تلمع رقاقات الثلج في الهواء، مما يخلق العمق والحركة.

الأسلوب والتقديم
واقعية الرسم مع فرشاة ناعمة. نسيج مفصل على العباءة والثلج. تركيبة متوازنة مع تباين قوي بين العباءة الداكنة والثلج الشاحب. خلفية ضبابية، وعمق الميدان.

Her figure occupies only the lower left third of the composition/ small and still against the monumental geometry of the space. The medium is charcoal and ink line work/ economical marks describing weight and texture. Every surface shows its age: weathered walls/ worn clothing/ the solidity of stone. The light is clear and physical/ falling from above like evening descending into a well.

prompts.prompt: / m1V8/ A woman in a flowing teal-green dress leans forward over a carved stone ledge/ her left arm resting on its surface/ her body three-quarter angled. Long pale blonde hair streams down past her shoulders/ catching warm light. Her face is tilted downward and slightly to one side/ eyes closed or half-closed in a moment of stillness/ mouth softly closed/ expression serene and inward. Behind her/ distant figures in deep robes sit or kneel in shadow—angels or witnesses rendered as soft presences. Above/ in the upper third of the frame/ more robed shapes populate the background in loose shadow. The entire background is a solid deep blue/ deeper at the edges. But from her chest and throat upward where the dress opens/ or where her head tilts back/ the interior is visible as a luminous chamber: intricate spiraling patterns in deep rose and rust forming geometric mandalas/ and within them/ pale clusters of mushroom-like forms as if her inner life were a glowing garden. This interior landscape has the same opalescent glow as her skin and hair/ the same substance as the white flowers she holds in her right hand. Rendered as oil on canvas throughout. Flesh tones are warm cream and pale gold with underlying rosy warmth. The dress is jeweled teal with visible brushstrokes showing folds and weight. The stone ledge is gray weathered limestone with moss in its crevices. Hair has the fine texture of spun silk/ catching light along each strand. The interior mushroom forms are rendered with soft rounded shapes/ slightly translucent/ as though luminous from within. Every surface shows the evidence of oil paint: the slight drag of bristles/ the build-up of glaze/ the soft glow that comes from layers of transparent color beneath opaque passages. The boundary where the interior landscape meets her external form is soft and blurred/ neither wholly defined nor wholly dissolved/ as if this strange growth is both fully present and dissolving back into mystery. The composition follows the rule of thirds with the high horizon placing her head and the internal garden near the upper third/ the witnesses and blue expanse below. The work feels like one painter's vision: rooted in classical romantic tradition but having discovered that the deepest intimacy is seeing and honoring what grows luminously within another.

prompts.title: Civitai prompt 143869248
prompts.prompt: Paint a 19th-century Russian scene in oils where a crowd has gathered in deep snow before a weathered European building. The building stands at middle distance/ its terracotta and rust-colored plaster rendered soft and almost glowing as it recedes into thick lavender-pink mist. Its shuttered windows and wrought iron balconies hold dark shadows. The foreground and lower two-thirds of the composition fill with dozens of figures—men and women in traditional Russian clothing: long coats in ochre/ green/ cream/ and gold/ head coverings white and earthen/ some carrying bundles or leaning on companions. Each figure is loosely painted/ nearly impressionistic/ their forms merging with falling snow and the haze that rises from the ground. Snow covers the lower edge and swallows feet. The light is diffuse—no sharp shadows—as though the scene exists in perpetual dawn or dusk under thick cloud. The horizon sits low/ barely a third of the way up the canvas. The sky above is pale lavender fading to warm white at the edges/ with no sun visible/ only the sense that light comes from everywhere and nowhere. The atmosphere is so heavy with cold and distance that the building floats like a memory. Render with loose brushwork/ blended edges/ and soft transitions between figures and snow and sky. The palette holds to purples/ grays/ lavender/ pale rose/ cream/ ochre/ and muted green—warm earth tones among cool atmospheric hues/ like heat memory meeting winter's hold.

prompts.prompt: / Bradhamel art style/ A woman's face in profile positioned at one intersection of the rule of thirds/ small against an immense flat saturated yellow background that fills nearly the entire frame. Her eyes are closed/ lids at rest/ brows soft and unfurrowed. Her mouth is neutral/ lips closed without tension. Dark hair falls past her shoulder/ individual strands visible. Her skin has the warm/ peachy undertones of late afternoon light. The image is shot with the architectural precision and documentary clarity of a photograph taken through a grid of window panes—sharp focus/ cool treatment/ as if the subject were viewed through glass divided into geometric sections. The yellow background is uniformly bright/ untextured/ providing absolute negative space that emphasizes the solitary smallness of the figure. The entire photograph uses the measured framing and formal grid-line thinking of architectural photography/ suggesting the woman is glimpsed through an invisible window of perfect panes/ held at a deliberate distance. The rendering is fine art photography/ film stock/ with the cool geometric sensibility of early twentieth-century pictorialism meeting contemporary portrait minimalism. Every detail of her face reads with quiet clarity: the curve of her cheek/ the angle of her jaw/ the length of her lashes against skin. The yellow fills all surrounding space without horizon/ without depth cues/ without anything else—only her small/ still profile occupies the frame.

prompts.prompt_ar: / أسلوب فن برادهاميل / وجه امرأة في صورة جانبية موضوعة عند تقاطع واحد لقاعدة الأثلاث / صغير على خلفية صفراء مشبعة ومسطحة ضخمة تملأ الإطار بأكمله تقريبًا. عيناها مغلقتان/ الجفون في حالة راحة/ الحواجب ناعمة وغير مجعدة. فمها محايد/شفتاها مغلقتان دون توتر. يتساقط الشعر الداكن على كتفها/تظهر خصلات فردية. تتمتع بشرتها بألوان دافئة / خوخي من ضوء فترة ما بعد الظهيرة. يتم التقاط الصورة بالدقة المعمارية والوضوح الوثائقي للصورة الملتقطة من خلال شبكة من ألواح النوافذ - تركيز حاد / معالجة رائعة / كما لو تم رؤية الموضوع من خلال زجاج مقسم إلى أقسام هندسية. الخلفية الصفراء مشرقة بشكل موحد/غير مزخرفة/ وتوفر مساحة سلبية مطلقة تؤكد على صغر الشكل الانفرادي. تستخدم الصورة بأكملها الإطار المُقاس والتفكير الرسمي لخط الشبكة في التصوير المعماري/ مما يوحي بأن المرأة يتم إلقاء نظرة عليها من خلال نافذة غير مرئية من الأجزاء المثالية/ يتم وضعها على مسافة متعمدة. العرض عبارة عن تصوير فوتوغرافي / مخزون أفلام للفنون الجميلة / مع الإحساس الهندسي الرائع للتصوير الفوتوغرافي في أوائل القرن العشرين الذي يلتقي بالبساطة المعاصرة في الصورة. كل تفاصيل وجهها تقرأ بوضوح هادئ: منحنى خدها/ زاوية فكها/ طول رموشها على الجلد. يملأ اللون الأصفر كل المساحة المحيطة بدون أفق/بدون إشارات عمق/بدون أي شيء آخر - فقط شكلها الصغير/الثابت هو الذي يحتل الإطار.
